environment.description: AWS Lambda function (Python 3.9 runtime) deployed behind API Gateway REST API with no request validation. Lambda has VPC access to pgBouncer instance on port 6432. Lambda execution role has AWSLambdaVPCAccessExecutionRole and custom policy allowing DynamoDB and RDS access. No input sanitization middleware. API Gateway configured with Lambda proxy integration, binary media types enabled including application/json. Lambda /tmp has 512MB ephemeral storage. No Lambda layers restricting imports.

config.api_gateway: REST API, proxy integration, no request validators
